properties.name: Belváros (városmag)
properties.method: Reuse of archived documentary road-centreline trace of municipal IVS annex1 unit1; source road geometry and ordered street-circuit proof are archived alongside this packet.
properties.approximationNote: Historical municipal unit1 is the narrower core described as Belváros (városmag). It is retained separately from the currently selected modern OSM Belváros footprint: areas approximately 0.662 versus 1.222 km² and intersection-over-union 0.483. Documentary street-side interpretation remains approximate. Existing archived coordinates are reused without alteration.

properties.name: Hagyományos beépítésű belső lakóterület
properties.method: Manual coarse trace of numbered historical municipal IVS overview-map unit; affine georeferencing to three archived OSM road junctions.
properties.approximationNote: Historical surrounding inner residential unit; the concave trace leaves Belváros, the separately numbered housing estates and their visible separators outside. Cadastral road 2606 is unresolved at street-side precision. The 480×476 raster supports only rough search-area geometry, with likely local uncertainty of tens to hundreds of metres. No point buffer or parent-place geometry was used.
properties.sourcePeriod: KSH 2001 census / 2003 internal divisions, reproduced in municipal IVS 2013
